Supreme Court SIT Flags Ram Temple Donation Theft; Chargesheet Expected

A Supreme Court-appointed Special Investigation Team (SIT) has identified 105 instances of theft related to Ram Temple donations. A chargesheet is expected within two days. The Congress party has criticized the delay in filing the chargesheet in this case.
